info.name: Telnyx Access Tokens Shared Campaigns API

params.name: page
params.description: The 1-indexed page number to get. The default value is `1`.

params.name: recordsPerPage
params.description: The amount of records per page, limited to between 1 and 500 inclusive. The default value is `10`.

items.docs:
Get all partner campaigns you have shared to Telnyx in a paginated fashion

This endpoint is currently limited to only returning shared campaigns that Telnyx
has accepted. In other words, shared but pending campaigns are currently omitted
from the response from this endpoint.

params.name: campaignId
params.description: ID of the campaign in question

params.name: page
params.description: The 1-indexed page number to get. The default value is `1`.

params.name: recordsPerPage
params.description: The amount of records per page, limited to between 1 and 500 inclusive. The default value is `10`.

params.name: sort
params.description: Specifies the sort order for results. If not given, results are sorted by createdAt in descending order.

items.docs:
Retrieve all partner campaigns you have shared to Telnyx in a paginated fashion.

This endpoint is currently limited to only returning shared campaigns that Telnyx has accepted. In other words, shared but pending campaigns are currently omitted from the response from this endpoint.
Update campaign details by `campaignId`. **Please note:** Only webhook urls are editable.
